title: Babies Tears, Soleirolia soleirolii, 2 Mini Plug Plants - Perfect For Terrariums
description: This set includes 2 mini plug plants of Soleirolia soleirolii, commonly known as Baby's Tears, ideal for terrariums due to its compact growth and vibrant green foliage. Easy to care for, this plant thrives in humid environments with indirect light and regular watering.
